answer: No mailbox, no identity: the registry sends a quartz token with a one-time code along a tracked delivery thread to that address, and only its returned code, matched to the thread, activates the identity. A hollow identity with no real mailbox gets no token, so it never activates. A second identity at the same address pays double the $6 fee, a third triple, pricing out clusters; spreading out needs a rented mailbox per identity, about $15 a month. Forging 1,000 puppets costs 1,000 x $6 in tokens and 1,000 x $15 a month in rent - $21,000 in month 1 - while an honest user pays $6 once.
